svg.text: One canonical vector atom, one reviewable path through real Office edits

g.text: PPTX is an authenticated edit branch

YOUR OPEN-ENDED EDIT / ADD SOMETHING THE BASELINE CANNOT PREDICT

svg.text: Success means Office edits return as an explicit patch and regenerate the same supported native drawing
